AFTERLIGHT FOR PARTNERS

Turn backup-power specs into a plan people understand.

Afterlight is a complete, public outage planner for households. It connects battery capacity, daily device use, water, and personal needs in one clear experience that can be branded, embedded, licensed, or acquired.
